title: A Girl Made of Hope
description: In “A Girl Made of Hope” by S.R., an EmpowerHer student, the writer tells the true story of Leila, an Afghan woman forced to flee her home to escape an imposed marriage and growing repression. Through quiet, powerful narration, the piece explores consent, displacement, and survival, showing how hope can exist not as safety or certainty, but as the courage to keep moving forward when everything familiar becomes a threat.
